interpretation: No failing run has an observed successful checkpoint followed by final collapse. Six failures remain low across recorded late-position evaluations; A L2 seed 3 shows substantial late improvement that remains below the registered 95% threshold.

High final training minibatch CE in the six low failures is consistent with incomplete optimization/learning under this budget. It does not establish a formal training-validation gap, because train accuracy and validation CE are absent and the logged training CE covers all positions.

Saved successful runs on the same task/settings show that the failure is not universal across runs. These curves cannot establish representational impossibility, prove that the intended algorithm was learned, or establish arbitrary-length capacity.

The observed variation is conditional on the registered finite compute budget, selected rate, initialization/training/evaluation seed, and full architecture. Curves alone cannot identify coupling as its cause or establish that extra steps, another rate, or a different initialization would repair any failure.
B succeeds on all six independent S5 confirmations here; this supports more reliable learning in this small registered sample, not a population-level reliability estimate.
limits: Selected seed 0 was used for learning-rate selection and is not an independent replication.
Seeds jointly alter parameter initialization, the generated training stream, and evaluation examples.
Equal counted FLOPs entail different update counts: A 5562/5550, B 6000/6000, C 5995/5995 for one/two layers; chosen rates also differ. Compare normalized budget fractions where relevant.
Sparse curve sampling cannot exclude transient unobserved successes or collapses.
Final validation/test agreement is descriptive; no late-score standard errors or paired predictions were saved.
No checkpoint, learning rate, run, or gate decision is changed by this analysis.

metric_semantics.balanced_late_accuracy: Mean per-class recall on scored positions 9 through 16 (T=17 including start token).
metric_semantics.cadence: Six intended approximately equal update intervals; some runs additionally record final update immediately after the sixth interval. No evidence about unrecorded intermediate states.
metric_semantics.test: Final-only independent 2048-sequence test set (seed 20000 + run seed).
metric_semantics.training_ce: Loss on the single fresh random training minibatch for the recorded update, across all 16 scored positions, computed before that update. Not an epoch mean or training accuracy.
metric_semantics.uncertainty: Balanced late accuracy SE was not saved; no train-validation gap or significance claim is computed.
metric_semantics.validation: Accuracy evaluated after the update on a fixed 1024-sequence validation set (seed 10000 + run seed). No validation CE is saved.

scope: All A/B/C S5 16-token word-problem runs at one and two layers: selected seed 0 plus independent seeds 1/2/3. Includes passing comparisons, not only failures.
